envelopes.authority: Goal-graph store head + branch-map receipt store

dataFields.fallback: groups relying on ledger render 'proof-needed' / gap detail
'derived at: missing'; freshness group in stale state
'Telegram initData and device artifact may still be required' detail line
branch-packets group blocked: 'Mission cannot trust branch state until packet rows arrive'
gates group idle: 'No founder approval is waiting.'
ActionRequestEmptyState box: 'No redacted ActionRequest rows are served yet.'
tools group stale: 'toolbelt commands unavailable until live data refreshes'
fallback social row; 'coordination evidence sanitized' gap note

dataFields.type: object (validated projection, digest re-verified at seam)
dataFields.fallback: branch-map pane hidden or gap; 404 graph head → empty panel
no sheet rendered; proof digests alone never imply layout

dataFields.type: {graphDigest, projectionDigest, sheetEnvelopeDigest, sheetTextDigest, generatedAt, proofDigest} (sha256:<64 hex> only)
dataFields.fallback: proof row absent; UI never requests raw graph payloads beyond the sheet

dataFields.source: derived client-side from envelope + bundled visual contract (shared/cambium-visual-contract.ts)

aliases.proof-needed: rows awaiting evidence; dashed hollow ring

derivation.complete: live-proof group with zero non-ready rows
derivation.blocked: policy gap, missing branch packets, branch-map digest/503 failure — peach
derivation.selected: focused group / expanded disclosure (SelectedHalo detail-sheet surface)
derivation.stale: freshness group past 360-min threshold; commands envelope missing
derivation.locked: proof rows behind unsigned gate actions
derivation.idle: groups with nothing waiting (gates idle, no action requests)
derivation.reducedMotion: static telemetry rows; reduced-motion proof row stays visible

loading.render: 'Synchronizing network / Please wait…' + linear progress bar

empty.render: dashed circle + node icon; 'No nodes discovered / Initialize a survey to begin exploring.' + outline CTA
empty.trigger: envelope groups all empty; branch-map 404 (no graph head)

error.render: peach warning triangle; 'Signal lost in strata / Check connection and try again.' + RETRY outline button
error.trigger: refresh route rejects; branch-map 401/503 surfaces as blocked group with redacted reason, never raw error internals
